name: Events Route - The Calendar With No Past Events Yet
description: The /events page for an organisation whose history has not started yet: everything in the collection is still ahead of today. The page opens with its OWN title and standfirst, then the live Luma calendar - and then stops. No Past Events grid, no link out to Luma's archive, no folded year rows, because there is nothing behind us to show. It is the counterpart to the upcoming-and-past scenario beside it and the state a brand-new chapter is actually in, which is the case most likely to be left unhandled: the page still has to read as finished rather than truncated. The title above the calendar is the change this frame carries - the page used to open on the embed's own heading, Full events calendar, so a visitor's first line of text belonged to a third party rather than to the site. NOTE ON THE FRAME: everything that differs from the upcoming-and-past scenario sits below the fold, so the capture hovers the webinars line at the foot of the page. The frame shows the bottom of the calendar running straight into that line and the footer, with no Past events heading or cards between them - the absence this scenario exists to prove. A resting capture would show only the top of the page, identical to its counterpart's.
